description: Song request queue visible to guests - guests can see the full queue of song requests: what has played (DONE), where their request stands in line (position number), what has been requested and by whom. First-come-first-served ordering by createdAt.
steps: Create a new guest API route at src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/requests/songs/route.ts that returns all SONG-category requests for the party, ordered by createdAt ascending (FIFO queue). Include fields: id, item (song name), deliveryValue (requester name since songs use NAME delivery), status, createdAt. This gives guests visibility into the full song queue.

Create a new guest component at src/components/guest/SongQueue.tsx that displays the song request queue with three sections: (1) 'Now Playing / Up Next' - the oldest NEW or SEEN request, (2) 'In Queue' - remaining NEW/SEEN requests showing position numbers and requester names, (3) 'Already Played' - DONE requests in reverse order. Highlight the current user's request(s) with a distinct style and show their queue position.

The SongQueue component should subscribe to SSE events ('request-update', 'new-request') via the existing guest events endpoint to update the queue in real-time when songs are marked as played or new requests come in.

Integrate the SongQueue into the guest flow: After a song request is submitted (in the existing RequestTracker view), show the SongQueue below the tracker so the guest can see where their song stands. Also add a way to view the song queue from the category selection page (a small 'View Queue' link under the Song button).
Update src/app/party/[guestCode]/page.tsx to add a 'Song Queue' view accessible from the main category selection screen via a subtle link, and shown after song request submission.
acceptance_criteria: Guests can see all song requests ordered first-come-first-served
Each song shows the requester name (deliveryValue) and queue position
The guest's own request is visually highlighted in the queue
DONE (played) songs appear in a separate 'Already Played' section
Queue updates in real-time via SSE when songs are added or status changes
The queue is accessible from both the category selection and after submitting a song request
verification: Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds with no TypeScript errors
Run npm test and confirm all tests pass
findings: Build and tests pass. Song queue API returns SONG-category requests ordered by createdAt ASC. SongQueue component shows Now Playing/Up Next, In Queue with position numbers, and Already Played (DONE reversed). Highlights current user's requests via myRequestIds prop. SSE events (request-update, new-request) drive real-time updates. Song queue accessible from category selection screen via subtle link and shown below RequestTracker after song submission. Review fix: added defensive null checks on SSE event data fields with early returns if required fields are missing. myRequestIds now persisted to sessionStorage keyed by guestCode to survive page refresh.
